answer: A saddler workshop record with harness order history works as the gate: harness orders fulfilled by one saddlery over years. Each of 311 aliases needs its own order histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The whisper test is the price tag: 311 fakes mean 311 payments. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The comet signal is visible to every grader, and the harbor ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
